weak.d: Humanity's Last Exam (22.0) — modest on pure-knowledge recall, consistent with agentic optimization over encyclopedic tasks.

res.d: AIME 2026 (94.7) — beats models 2-3x its parameter count; strongest reported figure on this card.

lims: Preparedness — resolves to "Moderate or lower risk" across Chem/Bio, Cyber, and Loss of Control without publishing red-team specifics.
Omits Llama entirely — Meta benchmarks against Gemma4 and Qwen3.6, not its own prior open-weight family.
blurb: Distilled from Muse Spark 1.2 and compressed to run on a single 24GB consumer GPU — Meta's first open-weight release since Llama 4, and a Meta card with a full, conventional benchmark table.
